statement: For each fixed integer m ≥ 0 and fixed 2 × 2 matrices D1, . . . , Dm, the homogeneous plane coefficients D ΩL, ADm L (xm) · · · AD1 L (x1)ΩL E (3.38) converge locally uniformly on Sm λ to a holomorphic function KDm,...,D1 (xm, . . . , x1). It is invariant under every common complex translation for which the translated arguments remain in the strip. For λ > 2π/3, the same functions are the array limits in (3.1). If vL is any fixed finite linear combination of row words applied to ΩL, then lim ∥AD L (x)vL∥2 ≤ 4∥D∥2 lim ∥vL∥2 . The two limits are determined by the word coefficients and the adjoint rule. This is the bound used to construct bounded row actions in Section 4. For λ > 2π/3, in the regular-filling procedure the expectations of every fixed equal-time local matrix product converge to those of the homogeneous plane construction.
